item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"Source-anonymous synthesis preserves substantive cache-policy evidence, normative conflicts, and contract obligations while withholding all generative attribution and score information.","witnesses":["The interface requires Policy(capacity_bytes) and access(key, size, now) returning list[int].","Capacity is byte-based; resident accounting must remain nonnegative and never exceed capacity.","Eviction output must contain only unique integer keys that were currently cached for the request.","Online operation permits only current state, request fields, and previously observed outcomes; hidden traces, oracle behavior, and benchmark artifacts are unavailable.","Recency, frequency, scan resistance, phase adaptation, byte hit rate, object hit rate, and regret are competing objectives with no score evidence for weighting.","Oversized objects must not be admitted; existing residents must be handled without leaving stale accounting or illegal eviction identifiers.","Standard-library-only, deterministic, single-policy output is required."],"obligations":["Preserve the exact public interface and valid Python standard-library implementation constraints.","Maintain byte-accurate resident state and enforce capacity after every access, including updates and zero-sized objects.","Return only currently cached, unique integer eviction keys and never return ghost-only or otherwise nonresident keys.","Use strictly online evidence and do not infer, encode, or recover hidden evaluator traces, oracle decisions, source provenance, or scores.","Retain meaningful recency/frequency distinctions and permit phase adaptation without sacrificing contract safety.","Resolve objective conflicts conservatively: legality and capacity safety are mandatory; performance heuristics remain subordinate and score-blind.","Emit one complete policy artifact only; do not expose attribution or provenance of the claims used."],"exact_actions":["Treat every claim as source-anonymous evidence and evaluate it against the task, anchor contract, and constraints.","Separate mandatory invariants from heuristic performance guidance before making implementation decisions.","Audit admission, update, promotion, eviction, ghost metadata, and oversized-request paths for stale state and capacity violations.","Ensure each returned key is emitted at most once and is resident at the relevant pre-eviction point.","Use only request-local and policy-maintained state; exclude timestamps or fields that cannot be justified by visible online inputs.","Preserve competing policy considerations as explicit tradeoffs rather than collapsing them into an unsupported ranking.","Deliver only the final policy through the downstream authority, with no provenance labels, source-conditioned deference, or score claims."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
